pages.text: $(thing)Black Rot of Crucifers$() ($(o)Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris$()), bacterium.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() brassicaceae.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() seedborne, rain splash, crop residue.
$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 15-35 °C (best 27 °C), humidity above 85%, 4 h of wet leaves.
$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 1 years (residue).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 50% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Hot-water treated seed; Rotation; Avoid overhead irrigation.
